deliverables: DeFi Kernel Registry Website and Submission Process, including public registry, submission process, compatibility requirements, documentation, reporting, onboarding support, and metadata for at least two smart contract packages

Spot Leverage Order Book, including protocol specification, smart contract design, testnet deployment, security review or audit report, mainnet deployment, published script hashes and schemas, adoption reporting, and integration documentation

American Options Market-Making protocol, including protocol specification, smart contract design, testnet deployment, security review or audit report, mainnet deployment, published script hashes and schemas, adoption reporting, and integration documentation

Composable DeFi Transaction Builder SDK, including SDK architecture, public API specification, registry schema reader, metadata parser, discovery helpers, transaction construction helpers, protocol adapters, alpha and v1 releases, examples, tests, integration documentation, and integration support
request.recipient: Dano Finance, with Minswap Labs serving as budget administrator
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Dano Finance's DeFi Kernel-related registry, Spot Leverage Order Book, American Options Market-Making protocol, and Composable DeFi Transaction Builder SDK.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 3,333,000 ADA total, consisting of 3,300,000 ADA for delivery and 33,000 ADA for a 1% budget administration fee.
Minswap Labs will serve as budget administrator for fund administration, milestone review, and accountability.
Dano Finance will support DeFi Kernel adoption by improving defikernel.org and a public registry where builders can submit compatible smart contracts and publish integration metadata.
The proposal will deliver two DeFi Kernel-compatible primitives, a Spot Leverage Order Book and American Options Market-Making Pools, plus a Composable DeFi Transaction Builder SDK.
Dano Finance currently has approximately USD 18M in TVL and more than 10,000 on-chain transactions.

The DeFi Kernel is intended to be an open, fee-free, and royalty-free compatibility standard that does not require payment, licensing fees, certification fees, listing fees, revenue share, or smart-contract open-sourcing.
Smart contract workstreams will include a security review or audit before mainnet release, and critical unresolved security issues will block affected mainnet milestones.

The proposal sets KPIs of at least USD 1,000,000 rolling 30-day trading volume for the Spot Leverage Order Book and USD 1,000,000 rolling 30-day option notional volume for the American Options protocol within 90 days of mainnet launch, measured using public on-chain data.
Unused or unearned funds, or funds tied to cancelled, undeliverable, or security-blocked milestones, will remain unspent or be returned according to the administrator's process.

Dano Finance will return 5% of protocol fees generated by the Treasury-funded Spot Leverage Order Book and American Options contracts for 12 months after mainnet launch, after specified direct costs, and report this publicly.

summary: The document requests 3,333,000 ADA for DeFi Kernel registry work, two DeFi protocols, and an SDK, with milestone structure, KPIs, security-review commitments, Minswap Labs administration, unused-fund handling, and a limited protocol-fee return commitment.
